description: Eight fixed synthetic content prompts; throughput coverage, not a quality leaderboard. One prompt per category, repeated measurements.

cases.prompt: Write a detailed technical explanation of how speculative decoding works in an autoregressive language model. Continue until the token limit and do not use a conclusion or summary.

Write a detailed original story about a lighthouse keeper who discovers a handwritten map in a bottle. Use natural dialogue, concrete descriptions and varied sentences. Develop the events gradually. Continue until the token limit; do not conclude or summarize the story.

Write Python code for an asynchronous HTTP job queue with bounded concurrency, retries with exponential backoff, cancellation, structured logging and unit tests. Use the standard library where practical. Output code and concise code comments, not an introductory explanation. Continue implementing useful tests until the token limit.

Write TypeScript code for an in-memory document search service: typed documents, token normalization, an inverted index, weighted scoring, pagination, deterministic tie breaking and tests. Output code with concise comments and no introductory prose. Continue adding implementation and test cases until the token limit.

Give a sequence of worked mathematics examples involving conditional probability, Bayes' rule, expected value, variance and a small linear system. Show the calculation steps and verify each result. This is educational visible working, not hidden reasoning mode. Continue with additional distinct examples until the token limit.

Escribe en español una historia original sobre una bibliotecaria que encuentra un catálogo de libros del futuro. Incluye diálogos naturales, descripciones concretas y acontecimientos graduales. Continúa hasta el límite de tokens sin cerrar la historia ni escribir un resumen.
请用中文写一篇原创故事，讲述一位修复古钟的工匠发现了隐藏在钟声里的地图。加入自然的对话、具体的环境描写和逐步展开的情节。持续写作直到输出长度限制，不要提前结尾，也不要总结。

Output a large JSON array of realistic synthetic inventory records. Every record must have id, name, category, quantity, unit_price, warehouse, tags and a nested supplier object with name and country. Vary the values. Output JSON only, no markdown fences. Keep adding distinct records until the output token limit. A token-budget truncation is expected in this throughput test.
